text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Oh, welcome back, Спешл Уик.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Huh?! You're here already?! Ahaha...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Wait, those shoes... Are you going for a
run?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's my daily routine.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Oh, is that right? ...Ah.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she'd let me run with her again
if I asked.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Maybe when she gets back, I'll work up
the courage to ask. Then
afterwards... Hee
hee!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
(That's right. I was thinking of asking her if
I could come... too.)
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
(Although... What if running together is
only fun for me? What if I...
just get in her
way?)
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Спешл Уик? Is something the matter?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, it's nothing! I'm gonna eat some
dinner. It's already dark
outside, so be
careful! See you later...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh no. If I don't leave now...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Hm, Suzuka? You're going running at this
hour?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Um... I don't plan on going very far, so if I
leave right now, I should be
back in time
before curfew...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Of all the—people like you really are
trouble. I'm tagging along.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: You're letting me run?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You were prohibited from running for
quite a while, so... it's not like I
don't
understand your urge to get back out
there.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(The streetlights flicker... and though the
days may still be hot, the
breeze at night
is so cool...)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: (It all feels... so good.)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Phew... Let's take a breather, Suzuka.
How's your leg? Does anything
feel off?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. My injury was only a sprain, after
all. I think it was excessive
to have me stop
running.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't think lightly of injuries you
incur while racing. Even the
smallest injury
could hurt your racing career.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
That's true, but... it was so hard not being
able to run.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I often found myself jealous of the others.
I'd lose track of time just
watching them
run.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
So all those odd complaints expressed to
the student council about
"feeling
watched" were because of you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'd also dream of running, and my legs
must have been actually
moving while I
slept. I would wake up with my futon and
covers all a
mess.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You were pretty lucky you had no
roommates to witness your alarming

sleeping habits.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I found myself spacing out in class, and
when called on by the
teacher, I'd stand
up and say, "I'm ready to run!"
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
First off, you need to pay attention in
class, Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
N-never mind that... The point is, I've been
having a hard time.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
That isn't hard to imagine, given your
stubborn obsession with
running.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Isn't it ironic? I came to this school and
started entering races because
I love
running. But that's exactly what lead to my
injury.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Hm...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Oh... That break was a little too long. We
have to get back before
curfew. Let's go,
Эйр Грув.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Pant... Phew.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Your form was a little sloppy, Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I was just... distracted.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
What, are you thinking racing doesn't
matter so long as you can still
run?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I believe there is a definite reason for you
coming here to Tracen
Academy.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Is there? What would that—
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
That is something you have to answer for
yourself... It's getting cold.
Let's head back
to the dorm.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
(I... love running. All alone, I run on and
on, always chasing after that
peaceful
scenery beyond.)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(But... isn't that something I can find while
running on my own?)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(In that case... why did I come to this
school to race?)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
